purpose: Continuous timeline scrub scheduling: released v0.1.6 baseline versus the uncommitted candidate on branch codex/loading-borders-scrub-regressions
stopRule: Accept only if median settle after the last input improves >= 20% or 250 ms, motion request starts do not increase, the all-age palette completes without restarts, no blank frames, rAF p50 <= 33.33 ms and >= 90% of baseline cadence.

environment.browser: Google Chrome stable via Playwright channel chrome, headed, mobile emulation 390x844 @2x touch
environment.network: CDP emulation: 60 ms latency, 1.5 MB/s down, 0.75 MB/s up
environment.servers: gzip static servers for the frozen v0.1.6 dist (/tmp/earthhistory-v016-regressions/baseline) and the candidate dist
environment.machine: macOS 25.6.0 developer workstation; runs sequential, one context per run
environment.gesture: load #age=0 with borders, wait for ready and background loading, then input ages 2..70 Ma in 2 Ma steps every 40 ms (crosses motion tiles 0-25, 25-50, 50-75)

candidate_flash_fix_only.note: earlier metric version; blank rows 0, request counts identical to baseline

unit: keeps a pending motion tile when a newer age lies in the same window
keeps a tile resident when its requesting age moved on before it landed
continues background timeline loading across foreground age changes
holds background body reads while a foreground tile is pending
defers all-age palette decoding until the foreground age has settled
finishes the all-age palette under the current age after a foreground change
browser: keeps the last rendered surface visible while a newer motion window is pending
witnesses.mutations: each unit witness and the browser witness failed under a deliberate reversal of its guarded line and passed after restoration

notes: Settle metric v1 searched from the end of the burst loop and misreported both artifacts; v2 measures from the last dispatched input. Chrome reports a single 100 ms long task when the all-age palette decodes; decoding is now deferred until the foreground has rested.
